# Pre-registration #2 — two observations generated by the discovery run
Locked 2026-09-18, AFTER discovery on DAX cash 2012-2019, BEFORE any holdout was run.

## Status of pre-registration #1
All 32 declared hypotheses FAILED. Nothing cleared |diff| >= 0.24 R with |t| > 3.15.
The largest was T2 "strong body 0.50-0.70" at -0.214 R, t = -2.32, which would look
significant at a naive p < 0.05 and is exactly what the correction exists to catch.
Discovery has therefore produced no confirmed finding. What follows are two NEW
hypotheses that discovery generated. They have not been tested on any holdout.

## H1 — alignment with the FIRST 15-minute bar
A trade taken in the same direction as the 09:00-09:15 bar closed has higher
expectancy than one taken against it.
Discovery evidence: +0.1269 R (n=1,239) vs -0.0412 R (n=1,286); difference
+0.168 R, t = +1.98. Fails pre-registration #1's threshold as eight separate
cells; this pools them into one test.
Control that makes it interesting: the SIGNAL bar's own direction shows nothing
(-0.063 R, t = -0.72). If the effect were a generic momentum artefact both bars
would show it.
PREDICTION: positive difference in all three holdouts.

## H2 — stop beyond the whole first half hour
Placing the stop beyond the extreme of the combined 09:00-09:30 range makes more
MONEY PER TRADE than Hougaard's opposite-trigger stop.
Discovery evidence: EUR 60.9 vs EUR 52.5 per trade (+16%), win rate 35.7% vs
31.6%, 2,291 trades vs 2,525 (9% fewer whipsaws), total EUR 139,412 vs 132,627.
Note honestly: in R this variant LOSES (0.0213 vs 0.0413), because a wider stop
inflates the denominator. Pre-registration #1 judged in R, so under that rule it
failed. This is a NEW hypothesis stated in money, not a metric swapped after the
fact to rescue a dead result.
PREDICTION: higher money per trade in all three holdouts. The R figure is
expected to stay lower and that does not count against it.

## Decision rule
Two hypotheses. Bonferroni alpha = 0.05/2 = 0.025, so |t| > 2.24.
H1 passes only if: same (positive) sign in ALL THREE holdouts, AND |t| > 2.24 on
        the pooled holdout data.
H2 passes only if: higher money per trade in ALL THREE holdouts.
A sign flip in any single holdout kills the hypothesis. No partial credit, no
"works on two out of three".

## Holdouts — read once, then this file is closed
A: DAX cash 2020-01-01 .. 2026-08-28
B: DAX futures 2021-08-30 .. 2026-08-28
C: NQ futures 2021-08-30 .. 2026-08-28   (different market: tests transfer)
Everything else about the configuration is unchanged from pre-registration #1.
